prepare_probe.script:
import pathlib,json,subprocess,hashlib,os,copy,time
p=pathlib.Path('/root/storage-probe');mount=pathlib.Path('/mnt/ac-juicefs');binary='/home/ac-test/agent-computer-storage-bazel';uuid=json.loads((mount/'.config').read_text())['Format']['UUID'];url='postgres://jfsmeta@10.0.2.15:5432/jfsmeta?sslmode=disable'
def save(path,obj):
 path.write_text(json.dumps(obj,sort_keys=True));path.chmod(0o600)
def run(args):
 r=subprocess.run(args,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True);return r
config={'mount_root':str(mount),'volume_path':'volume-preparation','filesystem_uuid':uuid,'volume_uid':'volume-component','object_cache':str(p/'objects'),'writer_uid':1000,'writer_gid':1000,'quota':{'executable':'/usr/local/bin/juicefs','executable_sha256':'sha256:'+hashlib.file_digest(open('/usr/local/bin/juicefs','rb'),'sha256').hexdigest(),'metadata_url':url,'password_file':str(p/'metadata-password'),'timeout_seconds':30}}
save(p/'config.json',config)
blob=os.urandom(1048576);sha=hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest();obj=p/'objects'/sha;obj.write_bytes(blob);obj.chmod(0o600)
manifest={'entries':{'src/input.bin':{'kind':'file','sha256':'sha256:'+sha,'size':len(blob),'executable':False},'empty':{'kind':'directory'}}};save(p/'manifest.json',manifest)
digest=run([binary,'manifest-digest','--file',str(p/'manifest.json')]);assert digest.returncode==0,digest.stdout
request={'organization':'org-final','volume_uid':'volume-component','workspace':'workspace-component','candidate':'candidate-one','computer':'computer-one','generation':1,'quota_bytes':1073741824,'manifest_digest':digest.stdout.strip(),'manifest':manifest}
def prepare(req):
 save(p/'request.json',req);return run([binary,'prepare','--config-file',str(p/'config.json'),'--request-file',str(p/'request.json')])
r=prepare(request);print('initial_prepare_exit',r.returncode,flush=True);print(r.stdout,flush=True);assert r.returncode==0
receipt=json.loads(r.stdout);data=mount/config['volume_path']/receipt['path_ref'];inputfile=data/'src/input.bin';assert hashlib.file_digest(inputfile.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==sha
assert obj.stat().st_ino!=inputfile.stat().st_ino and inputfile.stat().st_nlink==1
print('independent_file_sha256',sha,'inode',inputfile.stat().st_ino,'data_inode',data.stat().st_ino,flush=True)
# Normal acknowledged preparation is replayable with the same inode and receipt.
r=prepare(request);assert r.returncode==0 and json.loads(r.stdout)==receipt
# Bind only the prepared leaf for the non-root operator probe. No control parent is exposed.
writer=pathlib.Path('/mnt/ac-candidate-writer');writer.mkdir(exist_ok=True);subprocess.run(['mount','--bind',str(data),str(writer)],check=True)
nonroot=['setpriv','--reuid','1000','--regid','1000','--clear-groups']
r=run(nonroot+['sh','-c','printf changed-by-writer > /mnt/ac-candidate-writer/src/input.bin && sync /mnt/ac-candidate-writer/src/input.bin']);assert r.returncode==0,r.stdout
r=prepare(request);assert r.returncode==0 and json.loads(r.stdout)==receipt and inputfile.read_bytes()==b'changed-by-writer'
print('retry_preserved_nonroot_edit',True,'cache_unchanged',hashlib.file_digest(obj.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==sha,flush=True)
changed=copy.deepcopy(request);changed['computer']='other-computer';r=prepare(changed);assert r.returncode!=0;print('conflicting_computer_exit',r.returncode,r.stdout.strip(),flush=True)
nextgen=copy.deepcopy(request);nextgen['generation']=2;r=prepare(nextgen);assert r.returncode==0,r.stdout;nextreceipt=json.loads(r.stdout);nextdata=mount/config['volume_path']/nextreceipt['path_ref'];assert hashlib.file_digest((nextdata/'src/input.bin').open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest()==sha
print('new_generation_independent',nextdata.stat().st_ino!=data.stat().st_ino,flush=True)
# Read the real directory quota at its published path, then force EDQUOT as UID 1000.
env=os.environ.copy();env['META_PASSWORD_FILE']=str(p/'metadata-password');qr=subprocess.run(['/usr/local/bin/juicefs','quota','get','--path','/'+config['volume_path']+'/'+receipt['path_ref'],url],env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,text=True);assert qr.returncode==0;print('published_quota',qr.stdout.strip(),flush=True)
r=run(nonroot+['dd','if=/dev/zero','of=/mnt/ac-candidate-writer/over-quota.bin','bs=1048576','count=1152','conv=fsync']);print('quota_write_exit',r.returncode,r.stdout.strip(),flush=True);assert r.returncode!=0 and 'Disk quota exceeded' in r.stdout
subprocess.run(['umount',str(writer)],check=True)
evidence={'filesystem_uuid':uuid,'receipt':receipt,'next_generation_receipt':nextreceipt,'input_sha256':sha,'input_bytes':len(blob),'binary_sha256':hashlib.file_digest(open(binary,'rb'),'sha256').hexdigest(),'juicefs_binary_sha256':config['quota']['executable_sha256'],'quota_refused_file_bytes':(data/'over-quota.bin').stat().st_size,'checks':['initial materialization and hash','independent file inode','exact retry','UID 1000 mutation via prepared leaf bind mount','retry preserves mutation','computer identity conflict','new generation independent','quota at published path','UID 1000 EDQUOT'],'limits':['single VM; no product runtime grants, lease, fencing or Kubernetes mount admission','no power loss or S3 failure injection','private input staging cache; Artifact authorization and object-store fetch pending']}
save(p/'result.json',evidence)
print('storage_probe_passed',True,flush=True)

fresh_read_probe.script:
import pathlib,subprocess,json,os,hashlib
p=pathlib.Path('/root/storage-probe');result=json.loads((p/'result.json').read_text());cold=pathlib.Path('/mnt/ac-candidate-cold');cold.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy();env['META_PASSWORD_FILE']=str(p/'metadata-password')
command=['/usr/local/bin/juicefs','mount','-d','--read-only','--no-usage-report','--cache-dir','memory','--cache-size','0','--buffer-size','64','postgres://jfsmeta@10.0.2.15:5432/jfsmeta?sslmode=disable',str(cold)]
r=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
(p/'cold-mount.log').write_text(r.stdout);(p/'cold-mount.log').chmod(0o600)
assert r.returncode==0,'cold mount failed; private log retained'
file=cold/'volume-preparation'/result['next_generation_receipt']['path_ref']/'src/input.bin'
actual=hashlib.file_digest(file.open('rb'),'sha256').hexdigest();assert actual==result['input_sha256']
stats=(cold/'.stats').read_text();metrics=[line for line in stats.splitlines() if not line.startswith('#') and 'object' in line and ('get' in line.lower() or 'GET' in line)]
observation={'actual_sha256':actual,'bytes':file.stat().st_size,'cache':'new read-only client; cache-dir memory; cache-size 0','object_get_metrics':metrics}
result['fresh_client_read']=observation
result['environment']={'kernel':subprocess.check_output(['uname','-r'],text=True).strip(),'os':'Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS','juicefs':subprocess.check_output(['/usr/local/bin/juicefs','version'],text=True).strip(),'postgresql':subprocess.check_output(['/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/postgres','--version'],text=True).strip(),'s3':'SeaweedFS 4.48; single VM HTTP with random private credentials'}
(p/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');(p/'result.json').chmod(0o600)
print(json.dumps(observation,indent=2))
subprocess.run(['umount',str(cold)],check=True)
print('fresh_client_read_passed',True)
